name: Frostwave
description:
A frosted-glass music widget for your desktop.

Shows the album art, song title, artist and album of the track playing in Spotify, YouTube Music, Deezer and other music players, with play/pause, previous/next, shuffle, repeat, a seek bar and volume control. The widget sits on the desktop below your windows (or floats above them) and is also available from the top bar.

Choose between frosted glass and blurred album art backgrounds, and adjust the blur, transparency, tint, corner radius and size. Other media players can be enabled in the preferences.

Album art is downloaded from the image address the media player provides. The copy-link button places the song's web link on the clipboard.
